transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

...I guess they brought me in because of work. At the warehouse. 

They said I keep... doing things. Like, freezing with my arms up by the forklift. Or copying the beeping sounds and the hand signals. Moving boxes in these... strange little patterns. Even when everyone is yelling for me to stop. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually high or overly energetic lately?
No. ...I don't think so. I haven't really felt like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Do you hear voices that other people can't hear?
...No. I don't... I don't hear anything like that. Just regular talking.
Do you believe that someone is trying to harm you or control you?
...No. I don't think so. I mean, nobody's trying to hurt me. I'm just... doing my job.
Have you had any recent seizures?
...No. I haven't had any of those. Just... no.
Have these episodes been happening for more than a month?
...I don't know about episodes. But... the talking, and just... things being confusing at the warehouse... it's been about six months, I guess.
When someone moves your arm or body into a position, do you sometimes stay in that exact position for a long time?

...I don't know about someone moving me. But... I guess that's why they brought me here. At the warehouse, I... I just stop sometimes. Like, by the forklift, I'll just freeze with my arms up. Or I'll start making the beeping noises it makes, doing the hand signals... moving the boxes in weird ways. Even when the guys are yelling at me to quit it, I just... I don't know.
Do you have beliefs that other people say are not true, but that you are certain are real?
...No. I don't... I don't really know what you mean by that. Just... no. I don't think so.
When someone tries to move your arm or body, do you keep that position afterward without trying to change it?
...I thought you just asked me that. Nobody... nobody tries to move my arms. I just... I told you what happens at work. That's all.
Do you ever feel certain that ordinary things around you have a special meaning meant just for you?
...No. I don't... I don't think things have special meanings. They're just... things.
Do people tell you that your speech is hard to follow or doesn't make sense?

...Yeah, sometimes. Like at work. The supervisor asks which pallets are going on the truck. I try to explain it, but... I guess my words just jump around. I'll start on the load sheet, and then... I don't know, I end up talking about my old house. Or fishing. Or church boxes. By the time I'm done... nobody knows what I meant. So... yeah. They say that.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was there?
...No. I don't hear voices. Just... regular talking. When people are there.
Do you believe that anyone is controlling your thoughts or actions?
...No. Nobody's controlling me. Just... my own thoughts.
When someone places your arm or body in a position, do you stay like that for a while?

...I don't know about staying in a position... but... I guess at the warehouse, sometimes I freeze up. Like... by the forklift. I'll just stand there with my arms up. Or... I'll copy the beeping noises it makes. And the hand signals. Or I'll move the boxes around in... strange patterns. Even when they're yelling at me to stop. I guess... that's why they brought me here.
Do you believe that other people are watching you or talking about you?
...No. I don't really... pay attention to them. I just try to do my job. I haven't noticed anybody watching me.
Have you been talking much less than usual lately?
...I don't know. I guess I talk when I need to. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you have any strong beliefs that other people say are false?
...No. I don't think so. I just... I just have my own thoughts. Nobody really says anything about them.
Do you feel that someone is trying to harm you?
...Harm me? No. I just... do my work and go home. I don't know why anyone would do that.
Has there been a time when you were sure something was true, but other people told you it wasn't?
...Not really. I mean, people disagree on stuff all the time, right? But... no, nothing like that. I just mind my own business.
